title: Introducing The Clo Vendor Leaderboard
description:
Introducing the CLO Vendor Leaderboard, a platform designed to showcase the world’s most digitally advanced partners. We aim to streamline how the industry identifies vendors who have mastered the CLO Ecosystem digital workflow.

To find the most digitally advanced partners, the CLO Vendor Leaderboard is based on five key criteria: 3D Capacity, Investment and Resources, Business Impact, Partnership and Strategic Vision.

The CLO Vendor Leaderboard debuts with a strategic focus on digital pioneers across Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. This year, we are proud to recognize the following vendors: Busana Apparel Group, Cobalt Fashion, Crystal International, GMS+, Hop Lun, Newtimes Group of Companies, Daehan Global, PT. Kahatex, and Trax Intertrade Co., Ltd. 🌟

This is just the beginning. We look forward to recognizing more global vendor leaders who are advancing digital collaboration, strengthening connections with brands, and helping build a more streamlined digital fashion supply chain. 🚀

Learn more about the Leaderboard at https://vendorleaderboard.clo3d.com/ and explore the benefits by connecting with the CLO team today.

Stay tuned for our CLO Vendor Leaderboard video series that dive deeper into each criteria and the success stories behind our 2026 vendors.
transcript: For us here at Clow, we hear from brands all the time. We're expanding our 3D design capabilities and building processes. Who can actually help us get there? And on the other side, top manufacturers, suppliers, and vendors are telling us, our teams are experts in Clow. We are 3D ready. Who's ready to take advantage of our capabilities? Say hello to the Clow Vendor Leaderboard. Your ultimate guide to finding and connecting with the perfect Clow partner. We've gone through our extensive database of suppliers and handpicked the most innovative and well-equipped companies in the Clow ecosystem. Using the leaderboard, brands can now effortlessly identify top partners that fit their digital strategy. No more old, linear back and forth. Say hello to a virtual circle of real-time co-creation. How they make the cut. We graded them on five key factors. 3D capacity. Their ability to produce diverse, high-quality 3D garments. Investment. A verifiable commitment to 3D technology and infrastructure. Business impact. Demonstrated success in accelerating go-to-market and delivering cost savings. Strong, collaborative relationships across the supply chain. And finally, strategic vision. A track record of organizational transformation and commitment to sustainability. Stop guessing and start maximizing your team's 3D potential today. Head to clow3d.com slash leaderboard and get started. Your perfect Clow partner awaits.
markdown_content: ## Clow’s Expanded 3D Capabilities and Need for the Right Partners This section frames why Clow is expanding its 3D design capabilities and production processes, and how partner manufacturers and vendors are positioned to support that growth. It also introduces the concept of a curated partner list for brands seeking stronger 3D collaboration. Clow receives frequent input from brands about expanding 3D design capabilities and improving building processes. On the other side, top manufacturers, suppliers, and vendors share that Clow teams are experts in Clow and are “3D ready,” signaling readiness to support broader digital strategy and co-creation. To help brands connect with capable collaborators, Clow presents the **Clow Vendor Leaderboard** as a guide for finding and connecting with the right Clow partner. The goal is to replace slow, traditional back-and-forth with a more direct, structured way to identify partners aligned to a brand’s digital approach. ## What the Clow Vendor Leaderboard Is This section explains what the leaderboard provides and how it helps brands identify suitable partners for their digital strategy. It emphasizes curated selection from Clow’s database and a faster path to collaboration. The **Clow Vendor Leaderboard** is an “ultimate guide” designed to help brands find and connect with the perfect Clow partner. Clow reviews an extensive database of suppliers and handpicks the most innovative and well-equipped companies within the **Clow ecosystem**. Using the leaderboard, brands can identify top partners that fit their **digital strategy** more effortlessly than before. The intent is to move away from an “old, linear” sequence of back-and-forth communications and toward a more connected, ongoing collaboration model—described as a **virtual circle of real-time co-creation**. ## How Vendors Make the Leaderboard: Five Grading Factors This section details the five criteria used to evaluate vendors and determine how they “make the cut.” These factors combine production strength, investment, measurable business outcomes, collaboration, and long-term strategic direction. Vendors are graded on **five key factors**: 1. **3D capacity**: Their ability to produce **diverse, high-quality 3D garments**. 2. **Investment**: A **verifiable commitment** to 3D technology and infrastructure. 3. **Business impact**: Evidence of success in **accelerating go-to-market** and delivering **cost savings**. 4. **Strong, collaborative relationships across the supply chain**: Demonstrated ability to work effectively within the broader ecosystem. 5. **Strategic vision**: A track record of **organizational transformation** and commitment to **sustainability**. Together, these criteria are designed to reduce uncertainty and help brands identify partners that can support 3D adoption and performance. ## Getting Started This section provides the access point for using the Clow Vendor Leaderboard and emphasizes the outcome: maximizing a team’s 3D potential. Brands can use the leaderboard to stop guessing and maximize their team’s 3D potential by visiting: **clow3d.com/leaderboard**.
